autostartHint: In development mode Windows starts start.bat (a terminal window is normal).
opacityHint: Lower values make the window more transparent.
alwaysOnTopHint: Stays above other windows. Clicking elsewhere will not pin it to the desktop.
welcomeNote:
Welcome to the Desktop Notes gadget.

Double-click opens the note in its own window.
Drag and drop cards into groups.
Settings: autostart and JSON location (e.g. Google Drive).
autoSave: Save to JSON on every change
backupHint: Backups are created in the same folder: a weekly and a monthly file (each overwritten) plus a new dated file every six months.
jsonHint: Choose a location such as your Google Drive folder so the file stays in the cloud. If the file already exists, notes are imported and merged with the ones you have.
lastGroup: At least one group must remain
deleteGroupMessage: Delete group “{name}”? Notes will move to “{fallback}”.
previewEmpty: Click a note to see the preview.
jsonUnreadable: The existing file could not be read.
jsonEmpty: The file contains no notes or groups.
jsonDuplicatesOne: 1 note already exists. Which version should be kept?
jsonDuplicatesMany: {count} notes already exist. Which version should be kept?
gadgetOnly: Desktop Notes runs as a Windows gadget. Please start it with npm run dev, not in the browser.
